name: NSB Gaia DR3 XP starlight independent validation reference v1
description: Maintainer-reviewed regional validation envelope for the Gaia DR3 XP-derived NSB starlight release artifact. The bounds are intentionally broad and are used together with flux conservation, finite/nonnegative checks, plane/pole contrast, longitude seam diagnostics, checksum pinning, and runtime self-load validation.
